news.headline: Arroyo was on the field for just 15 of the team's 70 offensive snaps, but he was at least able to secure his first catch
news.detail: Arroyo was on the field for just 15 of the team's 70 offensive snaps, but he was at least able to secure his first catch of the year in the victory. The tight end logged 13 snaps with the special-teams unit, and at this point, he doesn't have any fantasy appeal unless something happens to AJ Barner.
